teaser: Sunnykumar K.'s seven IAM predictions for 2027, checked against agent teams that run today: four already here, one agreed, two different bets.
core_idea: Most of the IAM future Sunnykumar K. predicts is how our agent teams already run: roles as names for written policies, many more agent identities than people, each with its own session key, sealed secrets instead of passwords, and evaluation at every wake with keys that expire; the board needs a count of controls enforced from above. Two bets differ: the policy should be open and read by many enforcers rather than consolidated in one platform, and access decisions should stay deterministic and outside the model.

quotes.text: In our teams it is already more than 30 to 1 in two days, for one person.
Continuous access evaluation, for us, is every wake asking again whether it may proceed.
quotes.why: What continuous means for an agent.
